facts.text: An example of a statistically meaningful stopping-performance claim is: for reverse low-speed worker encounters sampled according to distribution P over the declared operating domain, the one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on successful stopping is at least X.

facts.text: A claim such as “we ran 20,000 scenarios with 99.8% success” is not statistically meaningful unless the scenario population and selection mechanism are specified.
facts.quote: A statement such as "we ran 20,000 scenarios with 99.8% success" is not meaningful unless the scenario population and the selection mechanism are specified.
